headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.title_zh: 受燃料价格下跌影响，中国7月工业生产者出厂价格涨幅放缓至3.5%
headlines.summary_zh:
中国7月工业品出厂价格涨幅放缓，国内燃料价格下跌缓解了美以对伊朗战争引发的成本压力，而高温天气拖累制造业。
国家统计局发布的数据显示，7月工业生产者出厂价格指数（PPI）同比上涨3.5%，低于6月的4.1%

headlines.summary:
Hong Kong’s commercial property investment more than doubled to US$3.1 billion in the second quarter, making it the fastest growing investment market in Asia-Pacific thanks to a strong increase in retail and office deals and a low base effect, according to JLL.

headlines.title: 上海：到2030年，上海软件和信息服务业产业规模力争达到4万亿元
headlines.summary: 上海印发《上海市软件和信息服务业发展“十五五”规划》。到2030年，把上海软件和信息服务业打造成经济增长“动力源”，AI赋能应用“主阵地”，参与全球竞争“桥头堡”，主要实现以下目标：产业总量规模进一步扩大，产业规模力争达到4万亿元，产业增加值突破1.1万亿元。产业质量效益进一步提升，在人工智能、关键软件等重点领域取得一批突破性成果，营收超百亿元企业增至35家，形成一批具有产业生态主导力的优质企业和具有潜在引领力的新兴企业。产业发展结构进一步优化，高端软件、数字内容、数智服务等产业比重进一步提升，培育和形成若干具有国际竞争优势的产业基地和区域性产业集群。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai: By 2030, Shanghai's software and information services industry scale aims to reach 4 trillion yuan
headlines.summary_en: Shanghai issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Shanghai's Software and Information Services Industry.' By 2030, Shanghai aims to turn its software and information services industry into a 'power source' for economic growth, a 'main battlefield' for AI-enabled applications, and a 'bridgehead' for global competition, with the following main goals: further expanding the industry's total scale, striving for an industry scale of 4 trillion yuan, and breaking through 1.1 trillion yuan in industry added value. Further improving industry quality and efficiency, achieving a number of breakthrough results in key areas such as artificial intelligence and key software, increasing the number of companies with revenue exceeding 10 billion yuan to 35, and cultivating a number of high-quality enterprises with strong industrial ecosystem leadership and emerging enterprises with potential leading influence. Further optimizing the industry's development structure, increasing the share of high-end software, digital content, and digital-intelligent services, and cultivating and forming several industrial bases and regional industrial clusters with international competitive advantages.

headlines.title_en: Shanghai: Supports software companies to widely use Coding platforms
headlines.summary_en: The Shanghai Municipal Commission of Economy and Informatization issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Shanghai's Software and Information Services Industry.' It mentions promoting the AI-driven development of software products, accelerating the intelligent upgrade of high-value scenarios such as industrial drafting, engineering design, and production scheduling, and strengthening the intelligent perception, analysis, decision-making, and execution capabilities of software products. It also supports the intelligent technological transformation of software enterprises, encourages the widespread use of Coding platforms, builds intelligent R&D and production lines covering the entire process and chain, and explores including investments in tokens, data governance, large model deployment, and retraining in the scope of enterprise technological transformation support.

headlines.title_en: Longsys: Obtains 720 million yuan special loan commitment for share repurchase
headlines.summary_en: Longsys announced that it recently obtained a 'Commitment Letter' from China Construction Bank Shenzhen Branch, agreeing to provide a special loan quota of no more than 720 million yuan for the company's share repurchase, with a loan term of no more than 3 years, specifically for repurchasing the company's A-shares. headlines.title_en: LiXin Energy: Electricity spot and medium-to-long-term market prices are affected by supply-demand and bidding mechanisms, with short-term tariffs showing a declining trend
headlines.summary_en: Li New Energy issued an abnormal movement announcement. The company's stock saw a cumulative closing price increase deviation exceeding 20% over two consecutive trading days on August 10 and August 11, 2026, which constitutes abnormal stock trading volatility according to the relevant provisions of the Shenzhen Stock Exchange Trading Rules. Affected by policy factors such as the deepening of power system reform and the decline of renewable energy subsidies, new energy power has fully entered the electricity market for trading, with the proportion of market-based trading electricity continuing to rise. Electricity spot and medium-to-long-term market prices are affected by supply-demand and bidding mechanisms, and electricity prices have shown a short-term downward trend. If the scale of market-based trading further expands and electricity prices continue to decline, the company's average on-grid electricity price faces a downward risk, which may adversely affect operating performance. headlines.title_en: ST Yifei: Other risk warnings revoked, resumes trading Aug 13 under new name Yifei Laser
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data August 11 - ST Yifei announced that the company's stock has been subject to other risk warnings since May 6, 2025, due to an adverse opinion audit report on internal control in the 2024 annual financial report. Currently, the company's 2025 internal control audit report is unqualified, and the impact of matters related to the 2024 adverse internal control opinion has been eliminated. The Shanghai Stock Exchange agreed on August 11, 2026 to cancel the other risk warning. The company's stock will be suspended for one day on August 12, 2026, and resume trading on August 13, 2026. The securities abbreviation will change from 'ST Yifei' to 'Yifei Laser', and the price limit will remain at 20%.

headlines.title: 韩媒：SK海力士计划将在中国的NAND产能提高50%
headlines.summary: 据韩国《首尔经济日报》报道，SK海力士重启中国大连NAND闪存生产基地的二期工厂建设，产能将扩大约50%。该工厂于四年前动工，后因存储器市场低迷而长期停工。SK海力士计划年内完成半导体生产设备导入，明年上半年正式投产。大连投资周期时隔四年再度开启，原因在于人工智能数据中心普及带动企业级固态硬盘需求激增，NAND价格在一年内上涨近十倍。

headlines.title_en: Korean media: SK Hynix plans to increase NAND capacity in China by 50%
headlines.summary_en: According to South Korea's Seoul Economic Daily, SK Hynix has restarted construction of the Phase 2 factory at its NAND flash memory production base in Dalian, China, with capacity expected to expand by about 50%. The factory broke ground four years ago but was suspended for a long time due to the downturn in the memory market. SK Hynix plans to complete the introduction of semiconductor production equipment within the year and begin formal production in the first half of next year. The resumption of investment in Dalian after four years is due to the surge in demand for enterprise solid-state drives driven by the proliferation of AI data centers, with NAND prices rising nearly tenfold in one year.

headlines.title: 韩媒《每日经济新闻》：SK海力士将重启中国大连NAND闪存产线投资，产能预计提升50%
headlines.summary: 8 月 11 日，据韩媒《每日经济新闻》报道，SK 海力士旗下 NAND 子公司 Solidigm 计划重启中国大连 NAND 闪存生产基地二期工厂建设，预计今年 11 月开始设备搬入，并于明年上半年正式投产。大连二期项目此前因 NAND 市场低迷、库存调整以及美国对华半导体设备限制等因素长期停滞。随着 AI 数据中心扩张推动企业级固态硬盘（eSSD）需求增长，SK 海力士决定恢复投资，以扩大 NAND 产能。大连一期工厂目前月产能约 10 万片晶圆，二期项目完成后预计新增月产能约 5 万片，整体产能将提升约 50%。SK 海力士计划采用「双轨生产」策略

headlines.title_en: Korea's Maeil Business Newspaper: SK Hynix to resume investment in Dalian, China NAND flash production line, capacity expected to rise 50%
headlines.summary_en: On August 11, according to South Korean media Maeil Business Newspaper, SK Hynix's NAND subsidiary Solidigm plans to resume construction of the Phase 2 factory at its NAND flash memory production base in Dalian, China, with equipment installation expected to begin in November this year and formal production in the first half of next year. The Dalian Phase 2 project had been stalled for a long time due to the sluggish NAND market, inventory adjustments, and US restrictions on semiconductor equipment exports to China. With the growth of enterprise solid-state drive (eSSD) demand driven by AI data center expansion, SK Hynix has decided to resume investment to expand NAND capacity. The Dalian Phase 1 plant currently has a monthly capacity of about 100,000 wafers. After the Phase 2 project is completed, it is expected to add a monthly capacity of about 50,000 wafers, increasing overall capacity by about 50%. SK Hynix plans to adopt a 'dual-track production' strategy
